verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the original. The stripe block floats with dead white bands above and below, the white card is cut short, and the product list falls off the card onto the blue/red stripe seam, where tiny dark text sits across two colours with weak contrast. B rearranges the layout and gives the $49.99 price clear dominance with a legible product list. But it breaks the copy apart: 'for all drinkware on' becomes illegible fine print at the very bottom, cut off from the price it qualifies. The URL shrinks to an unreadable vertical sliver in the top-right corner, and the stripes become disconnected floating bars of uneven length.
